risk: Roster semantics and decision-time availability are not established.
evidence: match_playing_xi contains only four identity columns; 5189 rows lack same-match delivery participation.
mitigation: Acquire source documentation and time-stamped announced lineup, substitutes, replacements, and availability.

evidence: No quota state at the proposed decision point; seven T20/overs metadata anomalies.
mitigation: Acquire format ruleset and decision-time legal overs remaining/penalty state.

risk: Outcomes for unused candidates are unobserved.
evidence: Raw deliveries identify the actual bowler only.
mitigation: Use prospective shadow logging for decisions; no retrospective imputation of alternative outcomes.

risk: Potential post-decision leakage if eventual participation is used as eligibility.
evidence: Delivery participation is an outcome after selection, not a recorded availability event.
mitigation: Enforce explicit decision-time evidence states and strict as-of feature construction.

evidence: Ingestion manifest has local hashes/timestamps but no source URL or license.
mitigation: Obtain original source packages, citations, license, extraction logs, and stable player/team ID dictionaries.

risk: Cross-team roster conflict and variable roster sizes.
evidence: One cross-team duplicate; match roster rows 21-25 and team rows 10-13.
mitigation: Flag conflicts; no source-row deletion or automatic correction.

risk: Role flags are incomplete and undated.
evidence: 3903 roster rows and 663 unique players have missing bowls_flag.
mitigation: Acquire dated role-source fields; do not derive role from observed bowling.
